title: Fourier degree of a path expansion
statement: Let $n$ and $k$ be natural numbers, and let $P$ be a finite list of paths on the binary cube with real outputs. If every path in $P$ fixes at most $k$ coordinates, then the vector Fourier degree of the sum of their outputs times their path indicators is at most $k$.
hypotheses_covered: The path list is finite and consists of paths on the binary cube with real outputs
Every path in the list has length at most $k
